name: metrics-report
description: Analyzes and reports on pipeline metrics collected by MetricsCollector during cargo-cicd execution. Extracts stage latencies (p50, p90, p99, mean, max), generates formatted performance reports, and tracks trends over time.
author: cargo-cicd metrics integration

parameters.name: output_format
parameters.description: Output format for the metrics report

parameters.name: compare_to
parameters.description: Path to a previous metrics file for trend analysis and comparison. If provided, generates delta analysis showing improvements/regressions.

parameters.name: save_to
parameters.description: File path to save the metrics report for tracking over time. Useful for building a historical metrics database.

parameters.name: threshold_ms
parameters.description: Alert threshold in milliseconds. Any stage exceeding this value will be flagged in recommendations.

parameters.name: log_level
parameters.description: RUST_LOG level for capturing tracing output (debug, info, trace)

command.description: Execute cargo-cicd pipeline with metrics collection enabled

steps.name: setup_environment
steps.description: Configure Rust logging to capture metrics tracing output

steps.name: run_pipeline
steps.description: Run cargo-cicd with advanced feature (enables MetricsCollector)

steps.name: extract_metrics
steps.description: Parse structured metric events from output

steps.name: calculate_deltas
steps.description: If compare_to provided, calculate trend analysis

steps.name: generate_report
steps.description: Format metrics into selected output format

steps.name: save_report
steps.description: Persist report if save_to path provided

parse_metrics_output.description: Extract stage latency metrics from MetricsCollector.report() output format

stage_events.elapsed_ms: integer - converted from microseconds to milliseconds

aggregate_stage_metrics.description: Compute aggregate statistics for each stage from histogram data
aggregate_stage_metrics.logic: For each stage histogram: extract count, p50, p90, p99, mean, max. Convert from microseconds to milliseconds for readability.

summary.total_pipeline_ms: number - sum of mean latencies across all stages
summary.slowest_stage: string - stage name with highest p99 latency
summary.fastest_stage: string - stage name with lowest p99 latency
summary.total_measurements: integer - sum of count across all stages

calculate_trend_deltas.description: Compare current metrics to previous baseline file
calculate_trend_deltas.logic: For each stage in current metrics: lookup stage in previous metrics and compute (current - previous) / previous * 100 for percent change. Mark regressions (>10% slower) and improvements (>10% faster).

trends.p50_delta_pct: number - percent change in p50 latency
trends.p90_delta_pct: number - percent change in p90 latency
trends.p99_delta_pct: number - percent change in p99 latency
trends.previous_p99_ms: number - baseline p99 from previous run

format_report.description: Render aggregated metrics in requested output format

notes.architecture: MetricsCollector (src/integrations/metrics_collector.rs) wraps StageLatencies (src/advanced/histogram.rs) which uses HdrHistogram for accurate percentile tracking. Each stage records latencies in microseconds (range: 1µs to 60s) at 3 significant figures precision.
notes.metric_units: Internal metrics use microseconds; reports display milliseconds for readability
integration_points: MetricsCollector::record_stage(stage_name, micros) - invoked by instrumented pipeline code
notes.performance_impact: Minimal - HdrHistogram uses fixed small memory footprint (~32KB per stage histogram). Thread-safe merge() allows parallel collection.

exit_codes.0: Metrics collection and report generation succeeded
exit_codes.1: Pipeline execution failed or metrics collection error
exit_codes.3: Output file could not be written
